thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/07/2019: TIVO, AAPL, QTRH, NVDA, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/07/2019: TIVO, AAPL, QTRH, NVDA, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.80%
AAPL: -0.18%
IBM: +0.41%
CSCO: -0.40%
GOOG: -0.02%
Technology stocks were declining pre-market Monday.
Early movers include:
(+) TiVo ( TIVO ), which was up more than 3% as it amended and extended the employment contract of interim president CEO Raghavendra Rau amid an ongoing strategic review at the digital entertainment company.
In other sector news:
(+) Nvidia ( NVDA ) was trading a bit higher as it unveiled its new GeForce RTX 2060, a graphics processing unit for desktop gaming, at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas.
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) was slightly down after a district court judge in California granted Quarterhill's ( QTRH ) WiLAN subsidiary an option to accept reduced damages in the amount of $10 million or to commence a new trial to determine the amount of damages in its patent dispute with the tech giant.
